how.title: From confusing to clear in under a minute
how.body: No medical words to look up. No scary search results. Just your report, explained calmly.
how.s1Body: Take a photo of each page, or add the PDF from your lab. We guide the camera so every value is readable.
how.s2Body: Each result is compared with the range printed on your report — worked out by simple rules, not guessed by AI.
how.s3Body: See the big picture first, then each result: what it measures, why it can change, and what to ask your doctor.

bento.title: Made for real families and real reports
bento.body: Keep every report organised, see how things change, and share a clear summary with the people who help you.
bento.trendsTitle: See how each result changes over time
bento.trendsBody: Every report adds a point. The shaded band is your lab's range, so progress is easy to spot.
bento.familyTitle: One app for the whole family
bento.familyBody: Keep reports for yourself, your parents and your kids — each in their own profile.
bento.whoBody: We suggest the type of doctor that fits your results, with one tap to find one nearby.
bento.shareBody: Send a tidy image or PDF to family or your doctor before the visit.
bento.privacyBody: No ads, no trackers, no selling data. Photos are deleted after 30 days by default, and you can erase everything in one tap.

principles.title: Clear and honest. Never alarming.
principles.p1Body: Whether a value is high or low comes from the range printed on your report, using fixed rules you can check.
principles.p2Body: We explain what tests measure and common reasons they change. We never tell you what you have, or to start or stop a medicine.
principles.p3Body: Every explanation ends with questions to ask your doctor, and a calm nudge when a result should be checked soon.

pricing.title: Simple, fair, no surprises
pricing.body: Start free. Pay only when you need more. Cancel any time.
pricing.trust: Secure checkout. We never see your card or UPI details.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.a1: No. Labwise explains what your report says in plain language. It never tells you that you have a condition, and it never suggests starting, stopping or changing a medicine. Your doctor makes those decisions.
faq.q2: How do you decide if a value is high or low?
faq.a2: We compare each value with the reference range printed on your own report, using fixed rules. AI helps read the report and write the explanation, but it never decides whether a result is in range.
faq.a3: Most blood and urine test reports — blood count, sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, kidney, liver, vitamins, iron and more — plus printed or handwritten prescriptions. We don't read scans, X-rays or ECGs.
faq.a4: Yes. We don't sell data, show ads or use trackers. We remove names, phone numbers and IDs before the AI reads your report where we can. Original photos are deleted after 30 days by default, and you can delete everything in one tap.
faq.q5: Can I keep reports for my parents?
faq.a5: Yes. Create a profile for each person and keep their reports and trends separate. Many people use Labwise to help their parents understand their results.
faq.q6: What if a result looks serious?
faq.a6: If your lab marks a value as critical, or it's far outside a safe range, we show a calm message asking you to speak to a doctor soon. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

final.title: Understand your next report in a minute.
